overview_description.description:
SoundBoks is a Copenhagen-based hardware start-up developing and selling battery-powered speaker.

Founded in January 2015, the company developed a shock and weatherproof design that is portable and durable, with up to 60 hours of battery life at loud volume. It also combines high SPL speaker units with a powerful amplifier in order to reach sounds with an output as high as 119db.

about_short_description.short_description: SoundBoks is a Copenhagen-based hardware company developing and selling battery-powered speaker.

product.name: Soundboks 4
product.description: A battery-powered Bluetooth party speaker for high-volume indoor and outdoor audio, with wireless speaker linking, app-based sound controls, and inputs for microphones, instruments, and mixers.

product.name: Soundboks Mix
product.description: A portable Bluetooth party speaker for everyday indoor and outdoor use, offering up to 121 dB, long battery life, app-based sound customization, and wireless linking with other compatible speakers.

product.name: Lightboks
product.description: A portable, battery-powered party light that reacts to audio, provides customizable RGBW lighting, and can synchronize multiple units through the Soundboks app.

product.name: Soundboks App
product.description: A mobile companion app for controlling Soundboks speakers and Lightboks, including sound profiles, equalization, wireless speaker management, security settings, and firmware updates.

product.name: The Battery
product.description: A removable LiFePO4 battery for Soundboks speakers, providing portable power, USB-C device charging, status indicators, and protection against overheating and short circuits.

product.name: The Backpack
product.description: A two-strap carrying backpack designed to transport Soundboks speakers, with an ABS backplate and fabric construction compatible with all Soundboks speaker models.
